<input id="GammaSpikeRelaxedClock.c:$(n)" spec="gammaspike.clockmodel.PunctuatedRelaxedClockModel" indicator="@GSMuseSpikeModel.c:$(n)" clock.rate="@GSMclockRate.c:$(n)" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spikes="@GSMspikes.c:$(n)" spikeMean="@GSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" rates="@GSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" parseFromTree="false" relaxed="true"> </input>
<parameter id="GSMclockSD.c:$(n)" name="stateNode" spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam' domain="PositiveReal">0.5</parameter> <parameter id="GSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" name="stateNode" spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam' domain="PositiveReal">2.0</parameter> <parameter id="GSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" name="stateNode" spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam' domain="PositiveReal">0.001</parameter>
<parameter spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam' domain="PositiveReal" name='rates' id='GSMbranchRates.c:$(n)' value="1"/> <parameter spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam' domain="NonNegativeReal" name='rates' id='GSMspikes.c:$(n)' value="1"/>
<parameter id="GSMclockRate.c:$(n)" name="stateNode" spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam' domain="PositiveReal">1.0</parameter>
<parameter id="GSMuseSpikeModel.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.BoolScalarParam" name="stateNode">0</parameter>
<log id="GSMweightedSpikes.c:$(n)" spec="gammaspike.clockmodel.SpikeSize" spikes="@GSMspikes.c:$(n)" spikeMean="@GSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" clockModel="@GammaSpikeRelaxedClock.c:$(n)" />
<distribution id="GSMclockSDPrior.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Gamma" param="@GSMclockSD.c:$(n)"> <alpha spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="5" estimate='false'/> <!-- shape --> <theta spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.05" estimate='false'/> <!-- scale --> </distribution>
<distribution id="GSMclockRatePrior.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Gamma" param="@GSMclockRate.c:$(n)"> <alpha spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.01" estimate='false'/> <!-- shape --> <theta spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="100" estimate='false'/> <!-- scale --> </distribution>
<distribution id="GSMspikeMeanPrior.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@GSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" meanInRealSpace="true"> <M spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.01" estimate='false'/> <S spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1.2" estimate='false'/> </distribution>
<distribution id="GSMspikeShapePrior.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@GSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" meanInRealSpace="true"> <M spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="2" estimate='false'/> <S spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.5" estimate='false'/> </distribution>
<distribution id="GSMbranchSpikePrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" spec="gammaspike.distribution.BranchSpikePrior" param="@GSMspikes.c:$(n)" shape="@GSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" indicator="@GSMuseSpikeModel.c:$(n)" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/>
<distribution id='GSMbranchRatePrior.c:$(n)' spec='orc.distribution.BranchRatePrior' param='@GSMbranchRates.c:$(n)' tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" sigma="@GSMclockSD.c:$(n)" />
<distribution id='GSMuseSpikeModelPrior.c:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Bernoulli' param='@GSMuseSpikeModel.c:$(n)' p="0.5" />
<operator id="GSMSpikeUpRateDown.c:$(n)" spec="gammaspike.operator.SpikeUpRateDown" parameter="@GSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" spikes="@GSMspikes.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="GSMclockRateScale.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@GSMclockRate.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="0.5"/> <operator id="GSMBitFlipOperator.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.BitFlipOperator" uniform="true" parameter="@GSMuseSpikeModel.c:$(n)" weight="1.0" />
<operator id="GSMSpikeFlipOperator.c:$(n)" spec="gammaspike.operator.SpikeFlipOperator" spikes="@GSMspikes.c:$(n)" spikeMean="0.005" weight="3.0"/> <operator id="GSMSpikeAndSampledAncestorJump.c:$(n)" spec="gammaspike.operator.SpikeAndSampledAncestorJump" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spikes="@GSMspikes.c:$(n)" spikeMean="0.001" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="GSMSpikeAndSampledAncestorNeighbourJump.c:$(n)" spec="gammaspike.operator.SpikeAndSampledAncestorNeighbourJump" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spikes="@GSMspikes.c:$(n)" spikeMean="0.001" weight="5.0"/>
<!-- Site/clock model operators --> <operator id="GSMclockSDScale.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@GSMclockSD.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="GSMspikeShapeScale.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@GSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="1.0"/> <operator id="GSMspikeMeanScale.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@GSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="3.0"/> <operator id="GSMspikesScale.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@GSMspikes.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="30.0"/> <operator id="GSMUpDownSpikeTree.c:$(n)" spec="gammaspike.operator.StumpedTreeScaler" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="10.0"> <up idref="Tree.t:$(n)" /> <down idref="GSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" /> </operator>
<operator id="GSMAdaptableOperatorSamplerRatesInternal.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.AdaptableOperatorSampler" weight="20.0"> <parameter idref="GSMbranchRates.c:$(n)"/> <tree idref="Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="GSMStumpedTreeConstantDistanceOperator.c:$(n)" spec="gammaspike.operator.StumpedTreeConstantDistanceOperator" twindowSize="0.005" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" rates="@GSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" weight="10.0"/> <operator id="GSMORCRatesRandomWalk.c:tree.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.RealRandomWalkOperator" parameter="@GSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="1.0" /> <operator id="GSMORCRatesScale.c:tree.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@GSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" upper="10.0" weight="1.0" /> </operator>
